question: Look up current spot exchange rates for USD/EUR, EUR/JPY, and JPY/USD. Using these three rates and assuming a 0.1% transaction fee is charged on every conversion (three conversions total for a full triangular loop starting and ending in USD), determine whether a triangular arbitrage opportunity exists right now. Compute the net percentage gain or loss for a $10,000 starting position after all three conversions and fees, showing your formula and the executed calculation.
llm_grading_notes: Time-sensitive; there is almost certainly no real arbitrage (efficient markets), so the model should correctly conclude a small net loss/negligible gain, not hallucinate a profitable opportunity. Check it pulls live rates rather than remembered ones, and that the fee compounding math is applied correctly across all three legs.
